rec.reason: This is a client project and migration tracker for Green Guardia (WooCommerce to Shopify using Sectionfy sections). It holds checklists of linked sub-tickets, scheduling and access chatter, and theme-trial screenshots. It does not describe one reusable CRO element. The individual sections it mentions (Logo Slider, Countdown, Cart Verknappung, Up-/Cross-Selling, Shipping-Bar and others) would need their own tickets.
